finalText:
Perfect! The website is fully built and ready. Here's what has been created:

## Summary

✅ **North Star Dog Grooming website** built in `./site/`

### Files Created:
- **index.html** — Home page (site root) with hero section, intro copy, image, and CTA
- **pricing.html** — Pricing page with service pricing and booking button
- **contact.html** — Contact page with location details (address highlighted per pen mark), phone, hours, and shopfront image
- **styles.css** — Professional responsive styling (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- **script.js** — Mobile hamburger menu functionality
- **assets/img_001.jpg** — Real grooming dog photo
- **assets/placeholders/blk_0011.svg** — Blue-door shopfront illustration (placeholder)
- **BUILD_NOTES.md** — Complete documentation of all build decisions

### Key Features:
✅ Professional playful design using primary color #3b6fb5  
✅ Fully responsive (mobile-first, tablet, desktop)  
✅ All navigation working (Home ↔ Pricing ↔ Contact)  
✅ Original client copy preserved verbatim  
✅ Professional intro text written: 2 warm sentences emphasizing one-dog-at-a-time service  
✅ Address line highlighted with visual emphasis (following client's pen mark)  
✅ Footer with business info and contact details on all pages  
✅ Accessible: skip link, semantic HTML, ARIA labels, WCAG AA contrast  
✅ Zero dependencies — pure HTML/CSS/JS, ready to deploy anywhere  

### Run the Site:
```bash
# Option 1: Open directly
open site/index.html

# Option 2: Local server
cd site && python -m http.server 8000
# Visit: http://localhost:8000
```

BUILD COMPLETE

entries: Copy: "Welcome to North Star Dog Grooming, your neighborhood's go-to spot for pampering your four-legged friend. We believe every dog deserves personalized attention in a calm, comfortable environment—that's why we take one dog at a time, ensuring your pup gets our full focus and lots of love."
Reasoning: Two warm, welcoming sentences that emphasize the one-dog-at-a-time differentiator and create an emotional connection with potential customers.
A red circular annotation was drawn around "84 Norfolk Street, north entrance" on the contact page
Implementation: Applied a light blue background with a left border in the primary color to visually emphasize this address line, making it stand out as the key location information
This follows the client's pen mark indicating this line deserves visual emphasis
Description: "The shopfront from the sidewalk so people can spot the blue door"
Current: `assets/placeholders/blk_0011.svg` — An SVG illustration showing a storefront facade with a prominent blue door and "GROOMING" signage
This is a placeholder and should be replaced with a real photograph of the actual North Star Dog Grooming shopfront
Business name and navigation links (Home, Pricing, Contact)
Contact details (phone, address, hours) for quick reference
Justified by brief: "minimal site footer (business name, a nav echo, copyright — plus contact details only if they already appear in the client's copy)"
Contact details appear in both the Contact page and footer for accessibility
Sticky navigation bar that remains visible on scroll
Mobile menu closes when a link is clicked
Secondary button color: #c97a3a (warm, playful, complements the primary)
Derived neutral and text colors for WCAG AA contrast compliance
System font stack for reliability and performance: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Roboto", etc.
80px gutters at ≥1200px as specified, 20px on mobile
Warm orange/brown color (#c97a3a) for call-to-action buttons
Rounded pill shape (24px border-radius) for playful vibe
Hover effect: slight darkening and upward translation for interactivity
Creates visual distinction without overwhelming the design
Home page: Links to Pricing and Contact; "See our prices" button → Pricing
Pricing page: Links to Home and Contact; "Book a spot" button → Contact
Contact page: Links to Home and Pricing
All pages have identical nav bar (Home, Pricing, Contact)
Footer echoes nav on all pages
Two-column grid layouts for hero and contact sections
Rows maintain side-by-side arrangement with proper gap
All rows stack vertically in order (left column first)
Hamburger menu (animated icon) replaces nav menu
Full-width images maintain aspect ratio with cover fit
Pure HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript
Opens with `open site/index.html` or serve from any web server
Accessible: includes skip link, semantic HTML, ARIA labels, WCAG AA contrast ratios
Home page image (img_001.jpg): 1600×1200 original, displayed at 496×320 with object-fit: cover, centered object-position
Contact page image (placeholder SVG): Responsive, scales to 424×288 desktop size
All images have descriptive alt text derived from client descriptions
Upload the `site/` directory to Netlify, GitHub Pages, Vercel, or any static hosting service.
